description: Two-tier canonical index. Tier 1 = shipped with repo (works for any user). Tier 2 = personal confirmed builds (gitignored, per-user). Use Tier 2 when available; fall back to Tier 1. RESOLUTION IS BY name + width READ LIVE (see resolution field) — NEVER by node id.
scoringFormula: floorplan(50%) + regions(30%) + components(20%). Threshold: >=85 clone direct, 60-84 clone+delta, <60 new build.

resolution.rule: Resolve every canonical in the LIVE Figma file by NAME + WIDTH. A stored node id is a HINT ONLY and must be asserted against the live name+width before any .clone().
resolution.why: AUDIT-V2 §8.4 P10. The index previously ranked "Outage List Overview" first with figNode 750:174925; live, that id is "Schedule Operation — State D EndOnly", a 560x430 dialog. A Level-2 clone by id would have silently built a list report from a dialog. Ids drift between files, duplicates and renames; names + widths read live do not.
resolution.onUnverified: An entry with "unverified": true has NO trustworthy node id. Resolve it by name+width live. If no live frame matches, treat the canonical as ABSENT — score it, but never clone it by id.
